usedFor: Shopify sees the sales events, and ActivitySmith puts them on your iPhone or iPad. When an “Order Cancelled” happens in Shopify, “Send Push Notification” in ActivitySmith tells you on your phone before you open the admin.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Send Push Notification” in ActivitySmith
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation is something you want to hear about fast, and it fires as the store reports it. “Send Push Notification” reaches your paired device, with optional buttons and channel targeting.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so a push from that trigger comes after a scheduled check and can be late. “Order Cancelled” is pushed by Shopify when it happens.
